note: Synthetic phone call transcript (spoken turns), based on Elisa's example. Names and node IDs are illustrative.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Hey Jari, yeah, quick one. MW-401 in Sodankylä is showing some errors since the weekend, not down though.

messages.author: Jari Jänne
messages.text: Okay so... errors how, like constant or in bursts?

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Bursts I think. I haven't been out there yet.

messages.author: Jari Jänne
messages.text: Hmm. Could be the fibre to the indoor unit maybe? I don't know, never seen that on that link.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Yeah, or the weather? It rained a lot.

messages.author: Jari Jänne
messages.text: Maybe, maybe. Hard to say without looking. Let's see if it gets worse.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Okay, yeah. I'll keep an eye on it.
